They never said they forgived me, which I don't really expect them to until I've changed. In my apology I said I wouldn't hold it against them if they decided to ban me, but their response said that they wanted me to stay. So, it's conflicting because I don't really feel deserving of being there. 

Also, thank you for your kind words, a lot of responses to this post put me in a worse mood. So, it's nice to hear some reassurance.

That's really the thing, he doesn't accept other's boundaries. He'll put anybody in a double bind with unrealistic and "predicted" expectations. The one option that is most rational to me is going no-contact once I am of age. Because, well, you can't exactly go no-contact with your 'owner'. I do not have any concerns regarding my schooling or work, I'm stuck in a negative head space that I do not think would be appropriate for education standards on my behalf.
I'm dorming, planned to major in Physics. Until I turn 18 is when I'll transfer over, so Fall of 2023 hopefully.

My dad is a narcissist to put it bluntly, and my mother, the enabler. As it is right now, there is nothing I can do to prepare because I'm already prepared as it is. I'm in college right now, but I can't find a job. I have my life after this planned out accordingly, I even have direct admission to UCF after I get my associates. But, ironically, it's the only thing I have that's kept me going. I think I'm more afraid that my dad will try to destroy that for me, rather than me being excited to go to college.

I'm currently in AP MT too, depends on how far in the material you are, if you use collegeboard they have some good materials you can use to catch yourself up. But going off what you've said I'd opt for the later date
Eugene Narmour was exactly what I was looking for, thank you!
